stories.headline: Updates to Full Disk Access in macOS
stories.summary: Updates to Full Disk Access in macOS October 2, 2026 We give developers powerful APIs to build incredible capabilities into their apps for Apple products, backed by a set of controls designed to protect users’ private data.  Full Disk Access largely sidesteps these controls in order to allow backup apps to function properly on the Mac.
